(3) Where  trading  in  the  securities  to  which  the

securities market of an exchange, the insider shall not directly
or  indirectly,  communicate  the  information  referred  to  in
subsection (1) or cause such information to be communicated
to another person, if the insider knows or could reasonably
be expected to know that the other person would or would
tend to –

(a)
acquire, dispose of or enter into an agreement with
a view to the acquisition or disposal of any securities
to which the information in subsection (1) relates;
or

(b)
procure a third person to acquire, dispose of or enter
into an agreement with a view to the acquisition or
disposal of any securities to which the information
in subsection (1) relates.
(4) A  person  who  contravenes  subsections  (2)  or  (3)
commits an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a
fine of not less than ten million rupees or to imprisonment of
either description for a term not exceeding ten years  or to
both such fine and imprisonment.
